channel.title: ClearHire Docs
channel.description: Build resumes, prove your employment history, and track applications.

item.title: ClearHire Changelog: Versions and Notable Releases
item.description: A high-level, honest changelog for ClearHire — the 2.15 rebuild on a new backend, what it added and dropped, and the 1.12.x line before it.

item.title: ClearHire Paid Plans: Requesting Pro or Team in the App
item.description: ClearHire's Pro and Team plans are requested in the app and set up on your account by the ClearHire team. Here is how a request works and what you see after it.

item.title: ClearHire on a Phone: The App View, Tab Bar and Account Sheet
item.description: On a phone ClearHire opens as an app, with a top bar, a tab bar and one action under your thumb. Here is what changes on a phone and what stays the same.

item.title: ClearHire Page Tours and the How ClearHire Works Page
item.description: ClearHire's page tours walk you through one page at a time, and the How ClearHire works page covers the product in six steps. Here is how both work.

item.title: ClearHire Resume Builder: Templates, PDF, and DOCX
item.description: The ClearHire resume builder turns your profile into formatted CVs with multiple templates, section control, and PDF or DOCX export — all free and in-browser.

item.title: Export a ClearHire Resume as PDF or DOCX Step by Step
item.description: Step-by-step guide to exporting a ClearHire resume as PDF or DOCX, when to choose each format, and how to fix common export and formatting problems.

item.title: How to Request Employment Verification in ClearHire
item.description: A step-by-step guide to requesting employment verification in ClearHire — how to send a request, what the employer sees, and how the request timeout behaves.

item.title: ClearHire: Verified-Employment Resume Builder
item.description: ClearHire is a resume builder and verified-employment job platform where past employers confirm your roles. Learn what it does, who it serves, and its limits.

item.title: About the ClearHire Team: An Independent Developer
item.description: ClearHire is built and maintained by an independent developer, the ClearHire team. What that means for you, where the other apps are, and how to get in touch.

item.title: ClearHire FAQ: Pricing, Accounts, Verification, Data
item.description: Answers to common ClearHire questions about pricing, accounts, employment verification, privacy, resume formats, platforms, account deletion, and who built it.

item.title: Analytics in ClearHire: Profile Views and Downloads
item.description: Analytics in ClearHire show your profile views, resume downloads, and application progress, turning job-search activity into signals you can act on.

item.title: Application Tracking in ClearHire: Applied to Offer
item.description: Application tracking in ClearHire organizes every job you apply to through stages from applied to offer, so you always know where each opportunity stands.

item.title: ClearHire Career Tools: ATS Checker, Cover Letters
item.description: ClearHire career tools include an ATS resume checker, cover-letter and bio generators, interview prep, salary insights, coding challenges, and career paths.

item.title: Company Reviews in ClearHire: Tied to Real Employment
item.description: Company reviews in ClearHire are mutual and tied to a verified employment link, so feedback comes from people who actually worked together. Here is how.

item.title: Employment Verification in ClearHire: How It Works
item.description: Employment verification in ClearHire lets a past employer confirm a role on your profile, adding a countersignature. Learn the request flow, timeout, and its limits.

item.title: ClearHire for Companies: Post Jobs, Verify, and Hire
item.description: ClearHire for companies covers company profiles, job posting, applicant tracking, talent search, employee reviews, and employment verification in one place.

item.title: Job Search in ClearHire: Filters, Alerts, Saved Searches
item.description: Job search in ClearHire finds roles with filters for location, remote, salary, and skills, plus saved searches and job alerts. See how it works and its limits.

item.title: ClearHire Notifications and Emails: In-App, Push, and Email
item.description: How ClearHire keeps you informed — in-app notifications for your activity, system announcements with three levels of loudness, optional receive-only push, and a few transactional emails.

item.title: Profile Management in ClearHire: One Career Record
item.description: Profile management in ClearHire keeps your career in seven structured sections that feed resumes, job search, and verification. See how it works and its limits.

item.title: Build Your First Resume in ClearHire: Step by Step
item.description: Learn to build your first resume in ClearHire — pick a template, choose profile sections, preview the layout, and export to PDF or DOCX in a few steps.

item.title: Create Your ClearHire Profile: 7 Sections Explained
item.description: Your ClearHire profile has seven sections that feed every resume and job match. Learn what each section captures, plus tips for completeness and privacy.

item.title: ClearHire Quick Start: Account, Profile, and Resume
item.description: A quick-start guide to ClearHire — create an account, complete your profile, and build and export your first resume in a few short, numbered steps.

item.title: ATS Resume Checker in ClearHire: How to Use It Well
item.description: Learn what an ATS is, how the ClearHire ATS resume checker scores keyword alignment against a job, and how to improve your resume — guidance, not a guarantee.

item.title: Exporting or Deleting Your ClearHire Data and Account
item.description: How to export your ClearHire data and how to delete your account and data using the in-app account-deletion flow, with a pointer to the full privacy policy.

item.title: ClearHire Privacy Summary: What It Stores and Shares
item.description: A plain-language summary of what ClearHire stores, the providers it uses, how verification data is shared, and your export and deletion rights.

item.title: ClearHire and Browser Extensions: There Is No Extension
item.description: ClearHire does not ship a browser extension. An earlier prototype captured LinkedIn profiles and auto-filled application forms; it was never published and is not part of ClearHire today.

item.title: Challenges, Badges and Levels in ClearHire
item.description: ClearHire has challenges, badges, levels and an opt-in leaderboard. Points come from finishing a challenge, never from opening the app, and there is no streak to break.
